label: Basundi
note: Milk simmered to about half and sweetened; thinner than rabri, which is boiled down further with the skins folded in

about.text: Basundi is an Indian dessert from Maharashtra and Gujarat made by slowly boiling milk until it is reduced by about half, then sweetening it with sugar, cardamom, charoli or saffron and serving it chilled with nuts.
